init_hand_poses_from_file: load hand pose data from a trajectory file and build a sorted timestamp index
get_data_statistics: get statistics about hand data including number of frames, right hands, and left hands
get_pose_at_timestamp: query hand poses at a specific timestamp with configurable time domain and query options
normalize_vectors: normalize a set of numpy vectors along a specified axis with optional numerical stability constant
compute_mesh_normals: compute the normals of a triangular mesh from vertices and triangle index arrays
